loss: CrossEntropyLoss with class weights from CNN train subject counts
frozen_test_policy: E03 test subjects are not used for training, validation, early stopping, model selection, hyperparameter tuning, augmentation decisions, or threshold selection.

validation_test_transform: Resize 224x224; grayscale repeated to 3 channels; ImageNet normalization.
